rules.description: Verified records must be sent simultaneously to PFMS to obtain beneficiary IDs and undergo second‑level verification.
rules.condition: When a record has been successfully verified
rules.outcome: The record is sent simultaneously to PFMS for obtaining the beneficiary‑ids and for second level verification
rules.evidence_quote: Since associating a beneficiary id with every record is an essential requirement for processing case on PFMS, all such records which have successfully been verified will be sent simultaneously to PFMS for obtaining the beneficiary-ids along-with for second level of verification (as also mentioned under para 2.3.2).
